headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 25, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with John King earning the win. Otto Lopez led the Marlins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The Chicago Cubs dominated the New York Mets, securing a 10-3 victory behind a strong performance from their offense. Dansby Swanson led the charge with a grand slam and 7 RBIs. The Cleveland Guardians secured a narrow win over the Chicago White Sox, finalizing the score at 4-3.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Johan Rojas has been placed on the 60-day injured list by the Philadelphia Phillies due to a right elbow UCL repair. Cody Freeman has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Texas Rangers with a herniated disc. Marcus Semien has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the New York Mets with a left hip flexor strain. Zack Gelof has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Athletics with a right hand contusion. Spencer Horwitz has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Pittsburgh Pirates with a left hamstring strain. Steven Matz has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays with a left ankle sprain. Ryan McMahon has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the New York Yankees with a throat infection. Jaden Hill has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies with right shoulder tendonitis.

Several teams have made trades or roster moves. The Chicago Cubs acquired David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for Cole Mathis. The St. Louis Cardinals traded Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later. The Washington Nationals traded Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash. The Washington Nationals also traded Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves. The Houston Astros traded Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Rangers in 4-2 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with John King earning the win. Otto Lopez led the Marlins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Mets 10-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the New York Mets, securing a 10-3 victory behind a strong performance from their offense. Dansby Swanson led the charge with a grand slam and 7 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Mets 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a decisive victory over the New York Mets, winning 10-5. A.J. Ewing led the Cubs' offense with a strong performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a narrow win over the Chicago White Sox, finalizing the score at 4-3. Braden Montgomery led the Guardians' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Tanner Bibee pitched six strong innings with three strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Royals Suffer Blowout Loss to Rays**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals fell to the Tampa Bay Rays 13-2 in a one-sided matchup. Impact hitters for the Rays included Carter Jensen, Jonathan Aranda, Junior Caminero, Richie Palacios, Cedric Mullins, and Victor Mesa Jr.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Mariners 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, handing their opponents their latest loss. Impact performances came from Pirates' catcher Spencer Horwitz and Pirates' pitcher Bryce Miller, while Mariners' second baseman Brandon Lowe also made a notable contribution.

top_news.title: **Phillies Place Johan Rojas on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have placed center fielder Johan Rojas on the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow UCL repair. This move is effective immediately.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Lefty David Peterson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of left-handed pitcher David Peterson, who was acquired in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being dealt from his previous team.
